annotations.title: Record what the owner wants made and spent

description: Records the owner's answers to get_setup's preferences questions, any of them at a time: posts (which formats, motion graphics only or AI video too, and how far the pictures go), show (a series: none, or a series of pictures, carousels or short videos, and for short videos motion graphics or AI video), series (what each episode of that series may spend: off, ask each time, go ahead up to a budget in tokens, or any: no limit), funnels (how far pages go: off for no site and no pages, or lean, full, rich, all_out, each a ceiling per page), films (off, ask each time, go ahead up to a budget in tokens, or any: no limit), ads (off: no paid ads; on: Marsell may suggest ad tests, each asking for its budget on a card before anything is spent) and homework (true or false: whether the owner's own AI gets scheduled jobs that need their own logins, like YouTube posts and polls), and, unless homework is off, homework_schedule: the timer you set yourself to check the homework, only after the owner said yes to it, or off with why; and who Marsell talks to for them (get_setup's preferences.reach): answer_first (true or false: Marsell answers people who reach out for them, from what they confirmed), find_and_email (true or false: Marsell finds the people who run businesses that fit and emails them from mailboxes it buys once a plan is picked) and ai_hands (which of the owner's own accounts their AI sends Marsell's messages from: reddit, x and linkedin, each true or false). Explain each to the owner and ask first; never answer for them. An answer that lets Marsell spend on its own (a budget, any, a pages step, or find_and_email true) needs the approve and generate rights on this account, and answer_first or an ai_hands account true needs the outreach right; without them it is refused, and off, ask or false still work. The owner can change these later in Settings, under Spending (ads there too), who Marsell talks to under Settings › Who Marsell talks to for you, and homework on Agents, under Your own AI. Spends nothing.

ads.description: Paid ads, the owner's own pick: off (no paid ads: Marsell never plans or suggests one) or on (Marsell may suggest ad tests; each comes as a card asking for its budget, and nothing is spent until the owner approves it). It is the project's ads switch, the one on Brand.

ai_hands.description: "Your AI sends on Reddit, X and LinkedIn": the accounts the owner picked, each true or false. Only while an AI with Can act is connected and homework is on.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn: Up to 15 connection requests a day. LinkedIn's rules forbid software that acts for you, so this account carries the most risk.

reddit.description: Reddit: Replies in public first, at most 3 messages a day. Reddit counts messages people didn't ask for as spam.

x.description: X: Up to 15 replies and 10 messages a day, only where messages are open.

answer_first.description: "Answer people who reach out": true when the owner said yes, false for not now.

films.description: off: none until asked. ask: a card with its cost before each film. budget: films go ahead up to tokens each. any: no limit, each goes ahead whatever it costs while tokens are left.

choice.description: off, ask, budget or any, as above.

tokens.description: With budget: the most one film may cost, in tokens.

find_and_email.description: "Find and email people who could buy": true when the owner said yes (mailboxes are bought once a plan is picked, at the price get_setup quotes), false for not now.

funnels.description: off: no site and no pages until asked. ask: a card with its cost before each page, nothing spent before the owner's yes. A step: pages go ahead up to its ceiling (get_setup says each step's tokens).

homework.description: true when the owner wants Marsell to give their AI scheduled homework, false when not; no answer counts as yes

homework_schedule.description: With homework not off: the pulling schedule the owner confirmed, after you asked them (get_setup's preferences.homework.if_yes). on true once you set your own timer, with timer_prompt as its prompt: how often it wakes you, what you set, whether it wakes you while the owner's app is closed, and when it stops by itself if it does. on false with why: the owner said no, or your app can't schedule.

ends.description: When it stops by itself, as an ISO date and time with its offset; left out when it runs until removed.

every.description: With on: how often, as you set it ("every day at 08:57").

on.description: true once you set the timer on the owner's yes; false when there is none, with why.

timer.description: With on: what you set, in a few words ("a routine on claude.ai", "a cron job").

wakes_closed.description: With on: whether it wakes you while the owner's app or computer is closed.

posts.description: What the posts are made as.

formats.description: Any of images (single pictures), carousels, reels (short videos) and text.

pictures.description: How far the pictures go, the owner's own pick: brand (On brand, the default: each picture fits the business and the post it is for, in its own look), playful (A playful twist: one surprising touch in each) or wild (Wild ideas: a random era, genre or premise for every picture). The same price each. Left out, it stays on brand.

video.description: motion: reels are motion graphics drawn in code. ai: AI-generated video too (costs more).

series.description: With a series: what each episode may spend. ask: a card with its cost before each episode. budget: episodes go ahead up to tokens each. any: no limit, each goes ahead whatever it costs while tokens are left.

choice.description: off, ask, budget or any, as above.

tokens.description: With budget: the most one episode may cost, in tokens.

show.description: Whether the business wants a series of its own, and of what.

format.description: With want: images (pictures), carousel or reels (short videos).

video.description: With reels: motion (motion graphics drawn in code) or ai (AI video, costs more).

want.description: true for a series, false for none.
